description: Estimate the price of a custom physical 3D2HOLO lenticular photo print when the user asks how much a print will cost. Use this tool when the user provides or asks about print dimensions and quantity. The quote includes the craft fee, lenticular grating/material fee, and shipping estimate, computed from current pricing rather than recalled from memory. Scope: physical print pricing only; the tool does not answer workflow, print-parameter, or calibration questions.

country.description: Shipping destination country/region (optional). Shipments to foreign destinations outside mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan include a 100g packaging box weight in the shipping estimate; omit to estimate for a foreign destination.

quantity.description: Number of prints (1-2000); checkout caps it per size/destination by the PayPal $10k per-transaction limit

name: get_print_quote
title: Get a 3D photo print price estimate
